camera.set_order: width, height, FPS, FOURCC LAST, then controls and exposure
camera.verification: All set returns true AND DSHOW/640x480/MJPG readbacks and fps within 0.01 of 30; exact camera controls control readbacks. AUTO_EXPOSURE getter=-1 is unsupported, manual response established by frozen prior image tests; AUTOFOCUS getter=2 is the previously verified manual flag. Verify after requests, settling, selftest, immediately before timing and after timing. On failure no session starts or completed session is invalid.
